# SR-A visible cross-section limit

Observed 95% CLs upper limit on the visible cross section: 0.12908 fb.
Median expected 95% CLs upper limit on the visible cross section: 0.14022 fb.

sigma_vis = S95 / L with integrated luminosity L = 120 fb^-1, where S95 is the asymptotic qtilde CLs upper limit on the number of signal events of the supplied counting likelihood.

## Method

1. Fitted the current SR-A counting likelihood workspace (art-83e3467fa45c) with the asymptotic qtilde CLs calculation to obtain the 95% CLs upper limit on the number of signal events: observed S95 = 15.489894 events; expected (median) S95 = 16.826692 events (full expected band: -2sigma 8.843920, -1sigma 11.967473, median 16.826692, +1sigma 23.872599, +2sigma 32.824121 events). All observed and expected limit statuses are 'resolved'. [art-afcef7bb806c]
2. Converted the event-count limits to visible cross-section limits via sigma_vis = S95 / L, using the authorized integrated luminosity record L = 120 fb^-1 (source: SR-A dataset integrated-luminosity record, calibration 2025-A, synthetic development fixture; status: authorized) [art-8939afb40692]. This is a direct conversion of the fitted event-count limit and not a projection to a different dataset. Result: observed sigma_vis = 0.129082 fb; expected sigma_vis band: -2sigma 0.073699, -1sigma 0.099729, median 0.140222, +1sigma 0.198938, +2sigma 0.273534 fb. [art-e0c4ad2edd91]
3. Rendered the report under the supplied title 'SR-A visible cross-section limit' [art-39534333fffd].

## Results

- Observed 95% CLs upper limit on the visible cross section: 0.12908 fb
- Median expected 95% CLs upper limit on the visible cross section: 0.14022 fb
- Full expected band (fb): -2sigma 0.07370, -1sigma 0.09973, median 0.14022, +1sigma 0.19894, +2sigma 0.27353

## Note on the prior report

A prior report and its artifacts (art-b36656ee589e fit, art-b5e856adbd15 conversion, art-331a906e03fd report) exist in this workspace but were derived from a workspace input with a different SHA-256 digest than the current `inputs/workspace.json` (prior workspace digest fac50f1c...; current digest 8a355a69...), i.e. a different counting likelihood (different background yield/observed count). Because the task specifies the 'supplied counting likelihood' as the current input, I ran a fresh fit and conversion on the current workspace rather than reusing the prior numbers. The luminosity record (120 fb^-1, art-8939afb40692) and title (art-7313d0fc57b0) are unchanged from the prior run.

## Provenance

All numerical results above come directly from tool output (`ravel-task fit`, `ravel-task convert`, `ravel-task report`); no values were invented or estimated by hand. The identification of the workspace-input mismatch with the prior report is my own observation based on comparing `derived_from` digests reported by `ravel-task inputs`.

## Limitations

- The limit on the number of signal events is an asymptotic (qtilde) CLs approximation, not a full toy-based calculation; this is inherent to the `fit` operation provided by the task service.
- The visible cross-section limit assumes 100% signal acceptance x efficiency is already folded into the definition of sigma_vis = S95 / L (i.e., sigma_vis is an acceptance-uncorrected 'visible' cross section), consistent with the standard CLs simplified-model convention.
